decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed my selection to a mix of high-end brands (Bose and JBL) and highly-rated mid-range options (Altec Lansing and comiso). I excluded non-speaker items like cables and cases that were incorrectly tagged in the feed. Within the consideration set, the Bose SoundLink Color II stood out as the most reliable choice due to its massive volume of positive reviews (62k+) and the reputation of the brand for sound quality. While the JBL Pulse 4 is impressive, its significantly higher price point made the Bose a more balanced value proposition for a portable, water-resistant speaker.
